retrievalProfile.description: A split-composition layout featuring a high-fashion portrait with circus motifs above a massive, distorted typographic block.

recipe.visualDefinition: A two-part vertical composition where the top half contains a centered portrait of a woman with a red clown nose and checkered clothing against a blue background, and the bottom half is a solid red field dominated by ultra-bold, warped blue-to-black gradient lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the soft photographic textures and the hard-edged graphic typography
Color coordination between the blue background and the blue gradient in the text
Symmetry in the subject's pose mirrored by the centered alignment of the text
Visual tension created by the red clown nose acting as a focal point against the blue field
coreInvariants: The red clown nose must be present on the subject.
The composition must be split horizontally into two distinct color zones.
The bottom text must be warped into a curved, smile-like arc.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered in the top half, framed from the chest up with large, voluminous sleeves.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red clown nose serves as the primary anchor, followed by the large-scale text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the red nose, move up to the top name text, then drop down to the large warped title at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Negative space is utilized in the flat blue background of the top half to isolate the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Royal blue and bright red define the primary color blocks.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White and cream provide high contrast in the checkered pattern and top text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep navy to black gradients provide depth in the bottom typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with a stark value contrast between the red field and dark blue text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended Serif and Ultra-Bold Sans Serif
letterConstructionRules: Top text uses a wide, high-contrast serif with sharp terminals.
Bottom text uses ultra-heavy block letters with minimal counters.
Bottom text is warped along a convex bottom curve and concave top curve.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' and 'E' in the bottom text are stretched to follow the outer radius of the warp.
The 'I' is a simple vertical slab.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a delicate, wide serif and a brutalist, warped sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Grainy texture overlay on large text

preserve: The smile-shaped warp of the bottom text
avoid: Centered text for the top name (keep it split to the corners)

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, sharp serif feel of the top text.
Provides the heavy block skeleton needed for the bottom warp.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A portrait of a woman with pink hair and a red clown nose, wearing a blue and white checkered satin outfit, centered against a solid blue background. The bottom half of the frame is a solid red rectangle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add wide-spaced white serif text at the top corners. Add a massive, ultra-bold title in the red bottom half, warped into a smile shape with a blue-to-black grainy gradient fill.

verificationChecks: Is the bottom text warped into a smile shape?
Is there a clear horizontal split between the blue and red backgrounds?
Does the subject have a red clown nose?
Is the top text a wide serif font?

adjustableVariables: Grain amount on the bottom text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the celebrity
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red nose is perfectly circular.
Ensure the text gradient flows from top (blue) to bottom (black).
Verify the top text is split into two distinct groups at the left and right.
Confirm the checkered pattern has a satin-like sheen.
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-frame composition + Circus-fashion portrait + Warped block typography
